source: Legacy geometry accepted as correct by Pranav 2026-10-26 without re-measurement (status "accepted"). The legacy FK applies the 45.5561 mm offset before yaw, so the yaw axis sits 45.5561 mm outboard of the legacy leg origin and the pitch axis lies on the yaw axis: modelled here as coxa_radial_m = 0 and mount radius 0.3 + 0.0455561 m. This reproduces legacy FK exactly (test_legacy_equivalence). Re-measure and switch any value to "measured" when checked on the robot.

That calibration limited knee encoder travel, which also moves with the hip, so this joint range is exact only with the hip at its reference
